Repo: https://github.com/clawdbot/clawdbot

GitHub issues/comments/PR comments: use literal multiline strings or `-F - <<'EOF'` (or $'...') for real newlines; never embed "\\n".

Source: `src/`; tests `*.test.ts`; docs `docs/`; output `dist/`; extensions `extensions/*`. Keep plugin-only deps in extension `package.json`; do not add them to root `package.json` unless core uses them. Installers: sibling `../clawd.bot` (`public/install.sh`, `public/install-cli.sh`, `public/install.ps1`).

Consider **all** built-in + extension channels for shared logic. Core docs: `docs/channels/`; core code: `src/telegram`, `src/discord`, `src/slack`, `src/signal`, `src/imessage`, `src/web`, `src/channels`, `src/routing`; plugins: `extensions/msteams`, `extensions/matrix`, `extensions/zalo`, `extensions/zalouser`, `extensions/voice-call`.

Docs: Mintlify, docs.clawd.bot. Internal links in `docs/**/*.md`: root-relative, no `.md`/`.mdx`; anchors use root-relative paths. When Peter asks for links, reply with full `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs. When touching docs, end reply with referenced `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs. README links must be absolute. Docs must be generic: no personal device names/hostnames/paths; use placeholders like `user@gateway-host` and “gateway host”.

Runtime Node **22+**; keep Node + Bun paths working. Install: `pnpm install`; also `bun install` (keep `pnpm-lock.yaml` + Bun patching in sync when touching deps/patches). Prefer Bun: `bun <file.ts` / `bunx <tool>`. Dev: `pnpm clawdbot ...` or `pnpm dev`; build `pnpm build`; lint/format `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format`; tests `pnpm test`, coverage `pnpm test:coverage`; live `CLAWDBOT_LIVE_TEST=1 pnpm test:live`, `LIVE=1 pnpm test:live`; Docker `pnpm test:docker:live-models`, `pnpm test:docker:live-gateway`, onboarding `pnpm test:docker:onboard`; full kit `docs/testing.md`.

TypeScript ESM; strict typing; avoid `any`. Run `pnpm lint` before commits and `pnpm test` (or `pnpm test:coverage`) before pushing logic changes. Keep files concise; extract helpers, not “V2” copies; use existing CLI option patterns and `createDefaultDeps`; aim under ~700 LOC (under ~500 when feasible). Pure test additions/fixes generally do **not** need a changelog entry unless user-facing behavior changes or requested.

Naming: **Clawdbot** product/app/docs headings; `clawdbot` CLI/package/binary/paths/config keys. Mobile: before using a simulator, check connected real iOS + Android devices and prefer them. **Device checks:** before testing, verify connected real devices (iOS/Android) before reaching for simulators/emulators. “restart iOS/Android apps” means rebuild (recompile/install) and relaunch.

Commits: `scripts/committer "<msg>" <file...>`; avoid manual `git add`/`git commit`. Changelog: latest released version at top, no `Unreleased`. PRs summarize scope, tests, user-facing changes/new flags.

PR review: use `gh pr view`/`gh pr diff`; do **not** change branches. Prefer one `gh pr view --json ...`; run `gh pr diff` only when needed. Before review of pasted Issue/PR: run `git pull`; if local changes or unpushed commits, stop and alert user. **Review mode (PR link only):** read `gh pr view/diff`; **do not** switch branches; **do not** change code.

Landing: create integration/temp branch from `main`, bring PR commits, apply fixes, run `pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test` locally before committing, merge back to `main`, `git switch main`, delete temp branch; contributor must be in git graph. If squash, add author as co-contributor. If review is followed by work, land via merge/squash, no direct-main commits, and always add author as co-contributor. End GitHub Issue/PR tasks by p
